title: A capture large enough to be downscaled before it is sampled
why: `contentBox` samples a downscale rather than the full raster, and that downscale is the one host-dependent step in the measurement. Through `drawImage` it is a filter no offline engine can reproduce; here it is the portable area average, so the two engines measure the same box. Samples 50–59 carry the mark, widened to 49–61 and mapped back by the inverse scale.
